issues.previous_text: após a SpaceX pedir até 1 milhão

issues.current_text: Zelensky reconheceu que 'a atenção dos EUA está no Irã'
issues.previous_text: negociações de paz com a Ucrânia estão em 'pausa' desde que a guerra desviou a atenção americana
issues.suggestion: Same narrative beat — US attention diverted from Ukraine to Iran — appeared 2 days ago via the Kremlin and now via Zelensky. Since 03-22 has new developments (Miami talks concluded, sanctions on Russian oil suspended), lead with those facts and drop or compress the 'attention diverted' angle that readers already absorbed.

issues.current_text: maior fábrica de chips da história ... maior força naval na região desde 2003
issues.previous_text: a maior ameaça à segurança energética da história
issues.suggestion: Three 'maior X da história/desde Y' constructions in two consecutive editions. The superlative-as-framing pattern is wearing thin. Keep one (TERAFAB is genuinely unprecedented), rephrase the naval coalition — e.g. 'coalizão de 22 nações com mais de 90 navios no Mar Arábico, escala não vista desde a invasão do Iraque'.

issues.current_text: agonistas GLP-1 cortam 15% do risco cardiovascular e 19% do renal — mas a proteção se reverte rapidamente ao parar o medicamento
issues.previous_text: FDA aprovou o Wegovy HD (semaglutida 7,2mg) ... Perda de peso média de ~21% em 72 semanas ... Eli Lilly respondeu com a retatrutida, primeiro triplo agonista GIP/GLP-1/glucagon
issues.suggestion: GLP-1 drugs were a headline story just 2 days ago (Wegovy HD approval + retatrutide). The new VA study adds real information (cardiovascular/renal data, reversal on cessation), but readers may feel saturated. Consider noting this is the third GLP-1 mention in a week, or compressing to one sentence that highlights only the reversal finding — that's the genuinely new and surprising angle.

issues.current_text: Brent atingiu $112/barril e subiu a $114 após o ultimato. Goldman Sachs projeta petróleo alto até 2027.
issues.previous_text: Brent fechou acima de $110 ... alta de 48% desde o início do conflito e quinta semana consecutiva de ganhos
issues.suggestion: Oil price update appears in every edition as a running counter. The 03-21 edition already contextualized the trajectory (48% since conflict start, 5 consecutive weeks). 03-22's $112→$114 is a modest move that doesn't need its own sentence. Fold it into the geopolitics paragraph as a parenthetical — e.g. '(Brent a $114)' — and save space for the Goldman 2027 projection, which is the new information.

issues.current_text: Tencent integrou o agente OpenClaw ao WeChat para mais de 1 bilhão de usuários
issues.previous_text: resposta direta ao OpenClaw, ferramenta open-source que Peter Steinberger criou antes de ser contratado pela OpenAI
issues.suggestion: OpenClaw appeared in consecutive editions. The 03-21 mention already introduced it and its origin. The 03-22 Tencent/WeChat integration is a distinct story, but readers seeing 'OpenClaw' two days in a row may feel it's the same beat. Add a brief connector — 'o OpenClaw que a Anthropic tentou rivalizar ontem' — or just name 'seu agente de IA' without repeating the product name.

summary: Moderate repetition: recycled Ramp/Anthropic data point, SpaceX million-satellite fact, and GLP-1 drug class all reappear within 2 days; 'US attention diverted to Iran' narrative and 'maior X da história' superlative framing are wearing out.
